about.body: Duna Shipping is a UAE-based international shipping and maritime logistics company working out of Hamriyah Port in Dubai, with more than a decade of experience in sea transport, cargo handling, container management and port yard operations. We serve traders, machinery and equipment suppliers, project owners and freight forwarders who need cargo loaded, documented and delivered without surprises — and every shipment settled transparently.
about.imageAlt: Aerial view of a port cargo yard with rows of heavy machinery and a barge alongside the quay

pillars.text: Load plans, lifting and lashing, stowage and inspections are carried out by our own port teams.
pillars.title: Hands-on operations

pillars.text: Voyage schedules and load lists are planned, executed and reported — not improvised.
pillars.title: Schedule discipline

pillars.text: Manifests, bills of lading, release and delivery orders are prepared from the same operational record.
pillars.title: Documentation accuracy

pillars.text: Quotations, proformas, invoices and customer ledgers in USD and AED, reconciled line by line.
pillars.title: Transparent accounting

operations.intro: Every shipment follows the same path. Each stage is recorded, approved and left ready for the next one, so nothing depends on memory or a phone call.

steps.description: We confirm cargo details, route, port of loading and discharge, then issue a quotation with the charges itemised.
steps.title: Enquiry & quotation

steps.description: Cargo is received, measured and registered with a unique reference, then placed in a specific yard location.
steps.title: Cargo receipt & yard intake

steps.description: Cargo is inspected and cleared for loading; anything that does not pass stays out of the load list until it is resolved.
steps.title: Inspection & readiness

steps.description: The load list is built against the voyage and then executed — actual loading is recorded against the plan.
steps.title: Load planning & stowage

steps.description: The voyage runs, the manifest consolidates the loaded cargo and bills of lading are issued for each consignment.
steps.title: Voyage, manifest & bill of lading

steps.description: Release and delivery orders complete the handover at destination, and invoices and customer balances are settled.
steps.title: Delivery & settlement
